svg.title: Upstairs: two bathrooms, three bedrooms — recommended renovation concept
svg.desc: Revised two-bathroom concept: both bathrooms have pocket doors and the hall linen closet is removed. The hall bathroom is approximately 92.25 by 72 inches with a 60 by 30 inch bathtub; its 4.5-inch pocket wall retains approximately 43 inches of wood landing depth. The primary bathroom is approximately 71.75 by 83 inches with a 36 by 52 inch finished shower, toilet and 30 by 18 inch vanity. A 42 inch hanging closet beside the retained chimney and 54 inches of shallow storage opposite the queen bed replace the walk-in closet. Three bedrooms, stairs and window opening locations remain. Approximate measured feasibility concept, not a permit drawing.
svg.text: Two bathrooms. Three bedrooms. A more useful primary suite.
Revised concept · pocket doors to both baths · linen closet removed · distributed bedroom storage
Driveway at top · front at left · rear at right · all three bedrooms retained
Finished-face planning dimensions; fixture and door sizes are nominal unless noted.
Room geometry follows the October 1 measurements and October 5 chimney correction.
A tub for the kids, a private shower
for the primary, and no new corridor.
Shower side exit: 35¾″ to rear wall.

Both rooms need exhaust to outdoors.
the current hall bath has a 2″ step.
